subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw keep configured model costs as USD-only estimates, add a scoped currency field for them, or limit non-USD currency display to provider billing snapshots?
rationale: The request changes public configuration and cost-accounting semantics across model config, session status, usage summaries, UI aggregation, and USD-named persisted/API fields; source inspection cannot safely choose that product contract.

options.title: Define a model-cost currency contract
options.body: Choose the currency scope and mixed-currency behavior before implementation so status, CLI, UI, docs, and stored usage stay consistent.

options.title: Keep configured model costs USD-only
options.body: Leave `models.providers.*.models[].cost` as USD estimates and rely on provider usage/billing snapshots for native currency balances or spend.

options.title: Allow a display-only override
options.body: Add a narrow formatter preference while explicitly documenting that stored and aggregated totals remain USD-like estimates.

recommendation.title: Define a model-cost currency contract
recommendation.body: Choose the currency scope and mixed-currency behavior before implementation so status, CLI, UI, docs, and stored usage stay consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across provider billing, cost analysis, and config contract surfaces that this product choice would affect.
